title: Case studies (all 10) + portfolio index: choose the structure
question: One template for every /portfolio/<slug> page; the /portfolio index files the same copies with divider tabs. No client quotes or ratings, only countable facts about what was built.

options.label: The Project Story
options.lineage: a magazine-style case study on pad paper
options.thesis: A long read: the client's problem, what was built, and the screens, with facts set in the margin like printed side notes.
options.viewport: Carbon strip with breadcrumbs, project title in Karantina and subtitle; a large stapled desktop screenshot overlapping into paper below. Then a reading column (about the project, features) with a narrow margin of facts (client, year, duration, category, tech), live-site link, and a closing slip.
options.risk: Several projects have short descriptions; the long-read shape can feel thin for them.

options.label: The Build Diary
options.lineage: a dated job log kept on the pad
options.thesis: The project told as a work log: what the client needed, what was built in which order, and what shipped.
options.viewport: Short carbon header with title and live link. Below, a yellow log sheet: entries (the need, the plan, features built, delivered) with screenshots pinned beside the relevant entry; facts strip; closing slip.
options.risk: The data has no real dates per step; the log must avoid inventing a timeline.

options.label: Delivered Order
options.lineage: the original work order, stamped delivered
options.thesis: Each project is its filled work order: client, category, what was ordered (features), with a red 'סופק' stamp and the screens clipped on.
options.viewport: Carbon field with a large tilted order form: header 'עותק לקוח No.', client name and project title as form lines, ticked features, a red 'סופק' stamp, desktop and mobile screenshots clipped to the side; below, about text, tech, more projects and a closing slip.
options.risk: Strong metaphor, but a lot of form chrome before the screens; must keep the screenshots big.

regions.label: order form: client, title, ticked features, stamp
